exact_primary_quotations: Nicotine EC result in increased quit rates compared to nicotine replacement therapy (NRT) (high‐certainty evidence) (RR 1.61, 95% CI 1.23 to 2.12; I² = 55%; 11 studies, 4114 participants). In absolute terms, this might translate to an additional four quitters per 100 (95% CI 1 to 7 more).

We also subgrouped studies based on whether single‐form or combination NRT was provided in the comparator arm. Four of the studies provided combination NRT, i.e. patch and another form (Bonevski 2025; Hajek 2019; Myers‐Smith 2022; Vojjala 2025); five provided single‐form NRT (Bullen 2013; Courtney 2025; Hajek 2022; Kouroutzoglou 2024; Lee 2018); and in two studies the NRT provided was unclear (Klonizakis 2022; Russell 2021*).

We did not detect evidence of serious short‐term harm from nicotine EC, but longer, larger trials are needed to fully evaluate safety. The included studies tested regulated nicotine‐containing EC; illicit products and/or products containing other active substances (e.g. tetrahydrocannabinol (THC)) may have different harm profiles.
Electronic cigarettes (EC) are handheld electronic vaping devices that produce an aerosol by heating a liquid.

Narrative summary of unpooled studies One study, Ioakeimidis 2018, available as a conference presentation only and considered at high risk of bias due to inconsistencies in the data reported, favoured varenicline for quitting compared with nicotine EC (cartridge) (RR 0.31, 95% CI 0.11 to 0.82; 54 participants; Analysis 2.1). In another study, Tuisku 2024 (refillable; low risk of bias), more people quit when randomised to receive a combination of non‐nicotine EC plus varenicline compared with nicotine EC (RR 0.73, 95% CI 0.53 to 1.01; 305 participants; Analysis 3.1), though the CI included the potential for no difference. Ioakeimidis 2018 and Tuisku 2024 were not pooled as, in the latter, a non‐nicotine EC was provided alongside varenicline, and evidence suggests non‐nicotine EC is more effective than no treatment. One study, Walker 2023 (pod; unclear risk of bias) investigated the effectiveness of nicotine EC versus cytisine and showed increased quit rates in people randomised to use nicotine EC (RR 1.56, 95% CI 1.06 to 2.30; 508 participants; Analysis 4.1). One study, Kouroutzoglou 2024 (device type not specified; unclear risk of bias), available as a conference presentation only and considered at unclear risk of bias, did not find a difference in quit rates between nicotine EC and combination NRT plus bupropion (RR 0.89, 95% CI 0.44 to 1.81; 38 participants; Analysis 5.1).

fields.before: 논쟁 있음. 세계보건기구는 전자담배를 금연 수단으로 권하지 않습니다. 장기 안전성 자료가 부족합니다. 젊은이가 전자담배로 니코틴을 처음 접하기도 합니다. 영국은 전자담배를 금연 서비스에 포함했습니다. 한국은 2026년 4월 24일부터 담배의 정의를 확대했습니다. "연초 또는 니코틴을 원료로 제조한 것"이 담배에 포함됩니다. 합성니코틴 액상형 전자담배도 법적으로 담배에 해당합니다. 소매인은 담배를 우편이나 전자거래로 팔 수 없습니다(「담배사업법」 제12조 제4항). 광고에도 제한이 있습니다. 담뱃갑에는 건강 경고를 붙여야 합니다. 금연구역에서 쓰면 과태료가 나옵니다. 소매인이 아닌 사람은 담배를 팔 수 없습니다(같은 조 제2항). 미성년자에게는 팔 수 없습니다. 문헌 검토에 포함된 니코틴 제품은 규제를 받는 제품입니다. 출처를 알 수 없는 액상은 검토 대상에 포함되지 않았습니다. 합성 대마가 섞인 이른바 '마약 전자담배'도 출처 불명의 경로로 유통됩니다. 제22절 제4항(낯선 사람이 주는 전자담배 카트리지 받지 않기)을 참고하세요. 먼저 제3항(금연약)의 방법을 시도하세요. 금연약이 더 싸고 근거도 더 확실합니다.
